subject.title: feat(sheets): support Connected Sheets (BigQuery data sources)

question: Should gog accept sponsored ownership for an opt-in, read-only Connected Sheets list/status surface before considering BigQuery-backed mutation commands?
rationale: The collaborator has already identified an ongoing ownership, OAuth, authorization, and live-integration testing commitment that cannot be resolved by implementation alone.

options.title: Keep deferred pending sponsorship
options.body: Leave this issue open until someone commits to ongoing ownership and a repeatable Connected Sheets test environment.

options.title: Sponsor read-only first
options.body: Approve a narrow opt-in list/status proposal with explicit BigQuery consent and live proof, while deferring add, refresh, update, and delete commands.

options.title: Decline core scope
options.body: Decide that Connected Sheets should remain outside gog’s supported CLI surface and close the proposal with an external-integration direction.

recommendation.title: Keep deferred pending sponsorship
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open until someone commits to ongoing ownership and a repeatable Connected Sheets test environment.

likelyOwner.reason: This person provided the current repository direction and stated the sponsorship and validation threshold.
